description: Classification of the IDL corpora in external/idl (git submodules). Files under a mustFail prefix are invalid IDL by their project's own test design (the upstream compiler must reject them).

ic-idl.why: IDL4 compiler with C/C++/Rust/C#/Java/Python/TS backends; codegen and HIR pass/fail tests

rtps-gen.why: IDL to Rust generator; per-construct test vectors and DDS IDL

hdds.why: pure Rust DDS; IDL samples used for Rust code generation

eprosima-idl-parser.why: Java IDL parser used by Fast DDS-Gen; XTypes test IDL

cyclonedds.why: idlc tests and DDS data types (XTypes: optional, keys, bitmasks)

glassfish-orb.why: idlj (IDL to Java) and CORBA OMG API IDL

jacorb.why: Java IDL compiler (OMG IDL-to-Java mapping); compiler succeed/fail regression IDL and OMG service IDL
